summary: Iteration 92: tested the stock chart fix, key figures, currency handling, the no-auto-execution order flow, search, watchlist, alerts and mobile layout, plus a regression check (preview only). Backend: 51/51 pytest checks passed. They cover all 7 ranges x 6 symbols (DBK, SAP, RHM, AAPL, NVDA, MSFT), each returning more than 2 points with ISO timestamps and the correct EUR/USD currency. Day stats are present. DBK volatility is 31.65 % (inside the expected 15-50 % band). Admin match returns disabled:true with orders_executed=0. A TEST 1x DBK limit buy at 5.00 stayed pending after a match call, was cancelled (200), and cash stayed at 300/300. UI: every range button 1T-5J renders a canvas with no 'Keine Chartdaten' message for all 6 symbols. Key-figure tiles are filled, US tiles, chart and 52W range show $, the badge tooltip text is correct, and the order hint about no broker connection is visible. Watchlist add/remove works, the price alert at 55.55 was created and then deleted via the UI, search finds AAPL (Apple) and SAP (Enter opens /aktien/SAP), and the Kennzahlen and News tabs load (News shows an honest 'Keine Meldungen zu DBK' fallback). At 390px there is no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 390). Regression: Übersicht, Mein Vermögen, Aufträge, IPO, Alarme and Favoriten all load. Remaining issues: the 'Eröffnung' tile shows the wrong value, the volume axis is labelled as a currency, the US headline price is in EUR while the rest of the page is in USD, the 1T axis uses UTC times, and the Vortag tile is always empty.

minor.issue: _compute_history_stats sets open_of_day = points[-1].open, which is the open of the LAST 5-minute bar, not the day's opening price. Verified examples: DBK 30.085 vs day open 29.855, SAP 210.5 vs 212.9, AAPL 346.54 vs 343.165. The 'Eröffnung' tile therefore changes every 5 min (seen 30,09 € then 30,02 €). Fix: for intraday intervals use the open of the first bar of day_date (dp[0]['open']).

The order always has currency 'EUR' and reserved_cash = limit*qty, even for US symbols. This is consistent only because the UI headline and limit field are in EUR (FX-converted), while chart and tiles are in USD. Please document or confirm this.

Admins can still execute orders manually through the internal execution saga. Only auto-matching (cron and admin match) is disabled. This is acceptable if intended, since the wording says 'intern verbucht, keine Börsenausführung'.

ui_bugs.issue: The volume last-value label on the right axis is formatted as currency, e.g. '97.727.735,00 €' (DBK 5J) and '770.677.647,00 $' (AAPL). The global localization.priceFormatter in lightweightChartTheme.js overrides priceFormat:{type:'volume'}. Fix: add lastValueVisible:false or a per-series volume formatter.

AAPL headline shows '311,62 €' (FX-converted) while the chart, Eröffnung/Hoch/Tief tiles and 52W range show '347,10 $'. On mobile the € headline sits directly above the $ chart, which looks inconsistent. Show the USD price (EUR as a secondary value) or label the headline 'umgerechnet in EUR'.

Intraday times are rendered in UTC, which is lightweight-charts' default. The DBK 1T axis runs 08:00-12:45 while German local time is 09:00-13:45 (CET). Also, the first axis label is clipped ('3:00'). Fix: shift timestamps by the local offset or use localization.timeFormatter.
The 'Vortag' (previous close) tile always shows '–' for every symbol, even though the data could come from the 5d/1mo history.

ui_bugs.component: Tages-Hoch/Tief for US stocks before the US market opens
ui_bugs.issue: The tiles show the previous US session (day_date 2026-10-27) without a date label.
The visible badge text is 'CACHE' (technical jargon) and the tooltip says 'Quelle: Yahoo Finance' for source=cache. The text 'Kurse können verzögert sein (EU-Aktien i. d. R. 15 Min.)' is correct.
The status shows the English 'Cancelled' while the table shows 'STORNIERT'.

issues: This page has no price chart (it is a research page), so the chart fix does not apply there.
The 'Finanzberater gesucht' career modal pops up over the stock page.
The chat FAB overlaps the lower-left part of the chart and volume bars.
The direction selector 'Über/Unter' is a native <select> rather than the shadcn Select.

action_items: Fix open_of_day for intraday ranges in routes/stock_public.py::_compute_history_stats: use the first bar of day_date, not points[-1].
Hide or format the volume last-value label in TradingChart.jsx (no currency suffix).
Make the US stock headline price consistent with the chart and tiles currency, or label it clearly as EUR-converted.
Optional: show intraday axis times in Europe/Berlin, fill the Vortag tile, show the German status 'Storniert' in the Aufträge timeline.
critical_code_review_comments: order_matching_service.run_pending_limit_buy_matching returns early with disabled:true. The code after the return is dead and should be removed or guarded by an env flag for clarity.
StockDetail.js is 1572 lines and should be split (chart card, key figures, order form).
The StockDetail chart, tiles and order form have very few data-testids (range buttons, key-figure tiles, watchlist button, alert input/delete have none).

success_rate.frontend: ~88%: core flows pass; open price, volume label and currency consistency issues

seed_data_creation: One TEST limit buy (1 DBK @ 5.00 EUR) for tester@mester.de, now status=cancelled (order id 6ae1f202e5bea6ddade60a60; remains as a cancelled record). A watchlist star on DBK was added and removed, and a price alert DBK > 55.55 was created and deleted. Final state: watchlist [], alerts [], positions [], cash 300/300 EUR, unchanged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: set localStorage kapitalmitte_cookie_consent and kapitalmitte_visitor_profile before login to skip the gates. Price alerts use /api/alerts (not /api/portfolio/alerts). The order quantity must be a string. pytest.ini uses xdist, so run with -n0 to see prints. Search is opened with Ctrl+K.
rca of the issue: Eröffnung: stock_public._compute_history_stats sets open_of_day = latest.get('open') where latest = points[-1]. For range=1d (5-minute bars) that is the last bar's open, so the 'Eröffnung' tile shows a near-current price instead of the day's opening price. Fix: when the interval is intraday, use dp[0]['open'] (the first bar with timestamp[:10]==last_day).
